title: Installments
lead: <c>{{amount}}</c> of the next {{count}} months is already committed to installments.
leadAfter: From {{month}} on it is at most <m>{{amount}}</m> a month.
empty: Upload a statement and your installment plans appear here.
chartLabel: Installment total per month. Details in the table below.
planCaption: Each row is one installment plan. A cell shows what you pay that month and which installment it is.
cashTitle: What a cash advance installment contains
cashLead: The remaining {{count}} installments add up to <m>{{total}}</m>. <m>{{principal}}</m> of that is principal; the rest is interest, BSMV and KKDF.

sim.title: What if I buy
sim.intro: I put a new installment purchase on top of your current load and show it on the chart. Nothing is saved.
sim.interestHint: Leave it empty and I count it without interest.
sim.result: This purchase adds <m>{{each}}</m> a month from {{start}} to {{ends}}.
sim.peak: The heaviest month becomes {{month}}: <m>{{total}}</m>. Today the heaviest is {{nowMonth}}, at <m>{{now}}</m>.
sim.peakSame: The heaviest month stays {{month}}; it goes from <m>{{now}}</m> to <m>{{total}}</m>.
sim.cost: With interest you pay <m>{{total}}</m> in all; <m>{{interest}}</m> of it is interest.
sim.beyond: The last installment falls outside the months shown, in {{ends}}.
sim.chartLabel: Installment totals by month with the new purchase added. Details in the table below.

payoff.open: If I pay it off early
payoff.title: {{plan}}: early payoff
payoff.description: I assume you pay every remaining installment together on the statement of the month you pick.
payoff.lead: Pay the remaining {{count}} installments together on the {{month}} statement and you pay <m>{{amount}}</m> for this plan that month.
payoff.nothing: This plan has no installments left from {{month}} on.
payoff.principal: If the bank drops the future interest, BSMV and KKDF, you pay <m>{{principal}}</m>; the difference is <m>{{save}}</m>.
payoff.note: I don’t know any bank’s early payoff discount. Ask your bank for the real amount.
payoff.noEffect: The totals in the months shown do not change.
payoff.notFound: I couldn’t find this plan; it may have been deleted or closed.
payoff.outside: This month is outside the months shown for the plan. Pick another month.
payoff.failed: I couldn’t work out the early payoff.
payoff.closedRow: Closed on the {{month}} statement, at installment {{index}}/{{count}}.

which.title: Which card today
which.description: If you buy in installments today, which card leaves the most days until the first payment.
which.label: Cards
which.row: It goes on the statement that closes {{cut}}, due {{due}}. The first installment is on the {{month}} statement.
which.shifted_one: The due date fell on a weekend or holiday and moved {{count}} day.
which.shifted_other: The due date fell on a weekend or holiday and moved {{count}} days.
which.projected: The statement does not print the next cut-off; I projected it from the last one.
which.stale: This card’s latest statement is old; the dates may drift.
which.none: Comparing cards needs at least one statement.

assumption.cut_off_day_included: A purchase on the cut-off day goes on that statement; a late posting by the merchant may move it to the next.
assumption.day_and_gap_kept: Unless the statement prints the next dates, the cut-off stays on the same day each month and the due date the same number of days after it.
assumption.due_on_next_business_day: A due date on a weekend or public holiday moves to the next business day without interest.
assumption.holidays_unknown: Religious holidays are missing for some years; for those I only checked weekends and fixed holidays.
assumption.stale_statement: Some cards have no recent statement; their dates are projected.
assumption.same_day_each_month: Without a printed next cut-off, I take the same day each month.

share.title: Shareable card
share.description: Share your installment load as one image without merchants, banks or card numbers. Amounts stay hidden unless you turn them on.
